speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Yellowish discoloration of the skin. I also have Discoloration started from the face then spread to the trunk, Scleral icterus noted. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Acute appendicitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Physiological Jaundice (Breastfeeding Jaundice).

The mention of appendicitis is medically impossible for a 5-day-old newborn and appears to be an error or a misunderstanding. Based on your age, feeding pattern, and the progression of jaundice to the trunk, this is consistent with physiological jaundice, which we expect to see peak around day 3-5. Your bilirubin levels will confirm this.
